title: Bloomberg Workshop
description: Two representatives from Bloomberg are coming to Brooklyn College! Students have the opportunity to learn about available software engineering roles at Bloomberg, get tips for technical interview rounds, and upload their resumes during the workshop.

title: GWC Meet and Greet
description: Come to Girls Who Code’s first club event of the school year. There will be free pizza, prizes ranging from BC merch to gift cards. A relaxing setting to meet with new people and make new friends.

title: Bake Sale
description: Support Computer Science Club by purchasing our baked goods. This can help fund future events that require funding, like hackathon or other tech events!

title: Tech Talk
description: Qingquan Li is hosting this week's Tech Talk Series. He will be talking about his summer internship at MTA, what technologies and tools he used, and what he learned from his experience.

title: Google Technical Interview Prep
description: Come learn the ins and outs of the technical interviews so you can nail your next one! Google Software Engineers will pull back the curtains on the interview process and give awesome tips & practice questions too.
location: Jefferson Williams Lounges, 4th Floor Student Center

title: Google Technical Resume
description: Come learn the ins and outs of the technical resume development so you can communicate your skills and experience!

title: CodePath Info Session
description: A CodePath representative is coming to Brooklyn College! RSVP for the chance to learn about everything that CodePath has to offer. CodePath is known for its FREE online tech courses, mentorship programs, and certifications! Students will learn about career readiness and how to stand out as an applicant.

title: Tech Talk
description: Anna Belenko is hosting this week’s Tech Talk Series. She will be talking about her internship at Vanguard in Pennsylvania, what technologies and tools she used, and what she learned from her experience at one of the largest investment companies.

title: Google Cloud Demo
description: Collaboration with Farmingdale State University, they're hosting a Google Cloud Demo, where they will showcase the power of Google Cloud through live demonstrations.

title: Behavioral Interview & Resume
description: ACE the Interview workshop led by John Cline and Emilie Hsieh. The workshop will be interactive and help you to market yourself on your resume and during the behavioral interview!

title: Technical Interview Workshop
description: ACE the Interview workshop led by John Cline and Emilie Hsieh. Learn applicable skills on how to successfully get through the technical interview and learn how to determine and approach technical projects you want to work on!

title: Career Panel Workshop
description: Join us for Career Panel Week! Hear from our bright-minded alumni who volunteered their time to share their journey, tips, and advice. This Thursday features our male alumni working in big tech, bridging software and hardware skills. Featured speakers: Oleksandr Lyoko (Amazon, Software Engineer), Alejandro Gonzalez (Amazon, ASIC Validation Engineer), and Kristian Mentor (Eventbrite, Senior Software Engineer & Founder of NULL NYC). Learn about working in big tech, ASIC validation, and entrepreneurship in tech. Food will be provided! Hosted by CIS Faculty, Workshop, and Computer Science Club. Email bc.cis.club@gmail.com for questions.

title: Google Cloud Workshop
description: Join us for a Google Cloud workshop hosted by Simon, the President of Google Developer Group here at Brooklyn College. He will be going over how to use Google Cloud. Donuts will be provided!

title: Blockchain Workshop - Sonic Labs
description: Meet Stephanie Ng, a Columbia University student who has interned at Nvidia and Intuit. She is the company representative of Sonic Labs, a start-up company that builds a high-performance blockchain, a layer-1 network. Learn how to create your first wallet app using Sonic Labs documentation and learn more about blockchain and cryptocurrency! Pizza will be provided, along with potential free company swag.

title: Girls Who Code Career Panel
description: Join the Girls Who Code and BC CS Club for a talk with software engineers from BlackRock, Macquarie Group, and Capital One. Hear from the sisters on what it's like to be a woman in tech, and how they build their careers from React systems to algorithmic trading. Meet the Panelists: Allina Khan (Computer Science Tutor, prev. Software Engineer at BlackRock), Amena Khan (Macquarie Group, Software Engineer), and Oleksandra Kurbanova (Capital One, Software Engineer). Free food will be available (popcorn chicken, crispy fries, and spring rolls).

title: UNADAT Workshop
description: The CS Club is hosting the Unadat Workshop with startup founders Sean and Dan who will share their real-world experiences, the challenges they've faced, the benefits they've gained, and the lessons they've learned along the way. They'll also offer advice on identifying strong startup ideas and knowing which ones are worth pursuing. Donuts will be served! Come learn, connect, and get inspired.

title: Tech Talk Series III: Hackathon Survival Guide
description: Munisa & Vanna recently participated at Hack Knight, Queen's College signature Hackathon. They will go through their experience surviving their first Hackathon, sharing insight on team matching, project planning, coding, and submissions. Come to learn how to get prepared for your first Hackathon!

title: FBI Office Visit
description: The Computer Science Club is excited to announce an upcoming visit to the FBI's New York office! Students will have the opportunity to attend a career panel hosted by FBI professionals, tour the facility, and wrap up the day with a stop at the FBI gift shop. If you're interested in learning about career opportunities with the FBI, don't miss out. Eligibility: U.S. Citizens and Permanent Residents only.
